product_one_liner.value: Doxis (formerly SER Group) provides AI-powered enterprise content management and intelligent content-automation software to organizations managing complex, document-heavy business processes.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes Doxis as an enterprise content management and intelligent content automation platform; it is intended for organizational users, especially enterprises with complex or high-volume document processes.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage and its navigation offer product information and demo/contact routes but no public pricing page or pricing link.

named_customers.notes: All three are named on Doxis's customer stories page.

employee_band.notes: The company's LinkedIn page reports 501–1,000 employees, which is outside the exact answer bands permitted by the schema. The status is unknown; the enum value is a placeholder because the schema requires one of its listed values.

hq_location.notes: The company lists its Bonn, Germany office at Joseph-Schumpeter-Allee 19 as its headquarters/address.

founded_year.notes: The company history in the release states it was founded in 1984.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains product, industry, and marketing-oriented material; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts on how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage/navigation does not provide a public product documentation/help portal, and the documentation URL located during research returned a 404 page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers listing includes a live Full Stack AI Engineer role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public product/AI information and related documentation/security material found during research; Doxis refers to AI models generally but does not publicly identify a model provider or specific model.

compliance_certs.notes: Doxis explicitly states that it has ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 certifications. GDPR is described as a compliance requirement, not counted here as a certification.

last_funding.notes: TA Associates became the new lead investor in March 2024, alongside existing investor Carlyle. The transaction amount was not disclosed; amount_usd is 0 as the schema has no null/undisclosed option.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified investment announcement was in March 2024, earlier than the 18-month lookback window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open roles include an Account Manager (New Business), Partner Manager, and Services Sales Manager, but none is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-10-19 Doxis announced a new SAP SuccessFactors Compensation integration, a product feature launch within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 19, 2026 announcement states that Yeelen Knegtering was appointed Chief AI Officer and Andy Spence joined as Chief Revenue Officer; both changes fall within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Doxis's integrations/business-connectors material names Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics 365 as supported systems.
